name: Luther Memorials in Eisleben and Wittenberg
description: In the Saxon-Anhalt towns of Eisleben and Wittenberg, you can walk through the places where Martin Luther was born in 1483, died in 1546, and sparked the Reformation. The sites include his Wittenberg room, the house of his fellow reformer Melanchthon, and the castle church where he posted his 95 Theses on 31 October 1517, an act that reshaped Western religion and politics.
